# Test fixtures

All fixtures are **synthetic and sanitised**: MAC addresses use made-up
values, IP addresses come from private / documentation ranges and hostnames
are generic. No data from a real router is stored here.

The Bandix fixture follows the field names documented in the upstream
Bandix README for v0.12.x (`data.d[]` with short keys). It should be
re-validated against a real Bandix 0.12.12 response during hardware testing.
